name: @jrootr/agent-trace
description: See what your AI agent actually did: an interactive timeline and call tree for Claude Code sessions and OpenTelemetry traces, in one self-contained HTML file.
author: Jake Sweany

scripts.test: node --test test/core.test.mjs test/claude-code.test.mjs test/otlp.test.mjs test/viewer-logic.test.mjs test/build.test.mjs test/cli.test.mjs test/opportunities.test.mjs test/security.test.mjs test/perf.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.coverage: node --test --experimental-test-coverage test/core.test.mjs test/claude-code.test.mjs test/otlp.test.mjs test/viewer-logic.test.mjs test/build.test.mjs test/cli.test.mjs test/opportunities.test.mjs test/security.test.mjs test/perf.test.mjs
scripts.version: node scripts/release-tools.mjs version && git add CHANGELOG.md README.md dist/
